content:
- Finished the conninfo boundary cleanup run end-to-end.
- Pushed commit 2034695 to origin/master and ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh successfully; it updated current_tasks files, sent the summary email, and repeated the non-fatal missing current_task.txt removal warning.
- Next, after a context reset: start by reading progress again; note the worktree still contains unstaged .ralph updates from post-commit logging/task-switch plus the pre-existing unrelated src/ha/decide.rs change.

- Read prior codex progress and confirmed the previous run already finished with a task switch.
- Loaded improve-code-boundaries skill instructions; next step is to inspect found_smells, worktree state, and lint/test entrypoints before choosing one boundary issue.
- Need to avoid unrelated user changes, apply one boundary cleanup, then run make lint and make test, commit including .ralph changes, push, and task-switch again.

- Inspected candidate smells outside src/ha/decide.rs and chose a self-contained smell-4 cleanup in src/config/endpoint.rs.
- The issue is duplicated endpoint rendering: to_client_string(), Display, and Serialize all represent the same boundary; plan is to remove the helper and let Display be the single text boundary reused by serde serialization.
- Next: patch src/config/endpoint.rs, add focused unit tests for IPv4/IPv6 formatting and serialization, then run make lint and make test.

- Patched src/config/endpoint.rs to remove DcsEndpoint::to_client_string and the separate format_host helper.
- Display now renders the endpoint directly, Serialize reuses Display via serializer.collect_str(self), and focused tests were added for IPv4, IPv6, and serde serialization.
- cargo fmt --check reported only test line wrapping; next is cargo fmt, then make lint and make test.

- make lint and make test both failed on the same compile error: src/dcs/worker.rs still referenced DcsEndpoint::to_client_string after the boundary cleanup.
- This is expected fallout from removing the duplicate string helper; next step is to switch that call site to the canonical Display/to_string path and rerun both gates.
- No bug task created because this is directly caused by the in-progress refactor and is being fixed in the same run.

- Rerun got farther: the compile fallout in src/dcs/worker.rs is fixed.
- New endpoint tests exposed an IPv6 formatting edge case: Display was double-bracketing because the parsed host already retains brackets in this codepath.
- Next: patch Display to preserve already-bracketed IPv6 hosts, then rerun make lint and make test until both pass.

- make lint passed after the endpoint/dcs adjustments.
- make test passed end-to-end with 236 tests passing; nextest also reported 5 leaky tests, but the target exited successfully and log conversion completed.
- Next: stage only the boundary cleanup files plus .ralph state, leave the unrelated pre-existing src/ha/decide.rs change alone, commit, push, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Staged only src/config/endpoint.rs, src/dcs/worker.rs, and requested .ralph files; left the unrelated pre-existing src/ha/decide.rs modification unstaged.
- Commit succeeded as 9df8c1c (Flatten DCS endpoint display boundary); post-commit docs publish/build hook completed successfully.
- Next: push 9df8c1c to origin, then run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh and note any resulting unstaged .ralph/task-state changes.
